lines.text: The Ziphites tell Saul that David is hiding, so Saul takes three thousand chosen men down to the Wilderness of Ziph.
David and Abishai come by night to the camp and find Saul asleep with his spear stuck in the ground by his head.
Abishai wants to strike Saul with the spear, but David refuses because Saul is the LORD's anointed.
David takes Saul's spear and water jug, then stands on a distant hill and rebukes Abner for not protecting the king.
Saul admits he has sinned and blesses David, and then David goes on his way while Saul returns to Bethel.
